step: dilute with skim milk and water
text: Water and skim powder take the place of fat and volume: three litres of toned milk come from about one litre of buffalo milk.

steps.note: Buffalo milk of 7–8 % fat is stretched to 3 % fat (toned) or 1.5 % (double-toned), which brings the solids other than fat back to 8.5 % or 9.0 %.
steps.what: skim milk or skim milk powder, and water

steps.note: The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
